description: PSD2 SCA Open Banking Agama flow (urn.openbanking.psd2.sca)

urn.openbanking.psd2.sca.rfacAppUrl: <RFAC_APP_URL - the App/IDP that collects the user's consent decision>
urn.openbanking.psd2.sca.consentApiAuthToken: <bearer token for the internal-consent GET, from the supplied ticket>
urn.openbanking.psd2.sca.consentApiBasicAuth: <base64 Basic-auth credential for the internal-consent GET, from the supplied ticket>
urn.openbanking.psd2.sca.trustedCallbackClientId: <OIDC client_id that is trusted to sign the RFAC callback JWS>
urn.openbanking.psd2.sca.testConsentApiKey: <TEST-ONLY: x-api-key for self-creating a consent, only used if testCreateConsent=true>
urn.openbanking.psd2.sca.testConsentAccessToken: <TEST-ONLY: bearer token for self-creating a consent, only used if testCreateConsent=true>
